classes.handling: Approved for intentional public release after rights, privacy, safety, accessibility, and claim gates.
Project roles only; do not publish by default.
Least-privilege access, purpose limitation, audit, encryption-appropriate storage, and redacted exports.
Store only opaque configuration/secret identifiers and stewardship metadata; never values.

rules: PII, contact details, submissions, consent evidence, mail bodies, credentials, tokens, environment diagnostics, and raw runtime payloads are excluded from unrestricted compendium leaves.
Public derivatives minimize fields and redact identifiers; irreversible anonymization must be verified before reclassification.
Retention is purpose- and authority-bound: record a schedule/trigger and responsible privacy role; where no approved duration exists, restrict access and open a question rather than invent a period.
Deletion requests and suspected exposure are escalated to role:privacy_steward; legal/operational holds are recorded, not silently bypassed.
Prototype storage is evidence of behavior, not proof that authentication, audit, backup, deletion, or retention controls exist.
